review_notes: I read the whole target file. I also read the Edge.lean statements of exists_tendsto_schwarzChristoffelPrimitive_sub_eq and ..._injOn_collinear, and the uses of these lemmas in Infinity/Basic.lean. I looked for an existing helper that identifies the boundary map with Edge's L on an interval and found none. Four theorems in the target (continuousOn, sub_eq, injOn, collinear) obtain L from Edge and then transfer each property to schwarzChristoffelBoundary by the same per-point rewrite. The other candidate repeats (the two continuity proofs, and the Ioo-neighbourhood step in the private existence lemma) are shorter or structurally different, so I did not report them. The saving is modest, a few lines per theorem. The main benefit is one shared identification statement.

findings.excerpt: schwarzChristoffelBoundary_eq_of_tendsto a e z₀ x (hL x hx)
findings.problem: Four different edge results each obtain an Edge witness `L` (from exists_tendsto_schwarzChristoffelPrimitive_sub_eq or ..._injOn_collinear). Each then re-derives, point by point, that `schwarzChristoffelBoundary a e z₀ x = L x` via `schwarzChristoffelBoundary_eq_of_tendsto ... (hL x hx)`. The transfer is done by hand each time: `congr` for continuity, a double `rw` for the increment formula, a double `rwa ... at hxy` for injectivity, and a `convert`/`ext` with two `rintro` branches for the collinear image. The identification `boundary = L` on `Ioo p q` is never stated as a lemma, so the same bookkeeping is repeated.
findings.proposed_change: Add one helper next to `schwarzChristoffelBoundary_eq_of_tendsto`, for example: `theorem tendsto_schwarzChristoffelPrimitive_boundary_of_mem_Ioo (a e) (z₀) {p q} (ha : ∀ i, e i ≠ 0 → a i ∉ Ioo p q) : ∀ x ∈ Ioo p q, Tendsto (schwarzChristoffelPrimitive a e z₀) (𝓝[upperHalfPlaneSet] (x:ℂ)) (𝓝 (schwarzChristoffelBoundary a e z₀ x))`. Better, state the Edge package with `L := schwarzChristoffelBoundary a e z₀`: `∃ L, EqOn (schwarzChristoffelBoundary a e z₀) L (Ioo p q) ∧ ContinuousOn L (Ioo p q) ∧ (increment formula) ∧ InjOn L (Ioo p q) ∧ Collinear ℝ (L '' Ioo p q)`. Alternatively, prove once that `hB : EqOn (schwarzChristoffelBoundary a e z₀) L (Ioo p q)`. The four proofs then reduce to `hLcont.congr hB`, `rw [hB hx, hB hy]; exact hsub ..`, `hLinj.congr hB.symm` (using `InjOn.congr`), and `hB.image_eq ▸ hLcol` (using `Set.EqOn.image_eq`). This removes the `ext`/`rintro` collinear block and the duplicated `rw`/`rwa` chains.
findings.benefit: The relation 'on a prevertex-free interval the canonical boundary map is Edge's continuous extension L' is proved once instead of four times. The four downstream proofs shrink to one-liners, and the collinear proof loses its two-direction set-extensionality block. Any later edge-property transfer, for example the derivative or the Icc continuity, can reuse the same identification.
